OPTIMIZE THE COMMON PATHS (Q&A, SIMPLE
SUGGESTION) FOR THE 2S FEEL PRIYA WANTS.
LET MULTI-TOOL CALLS (EQUIPMENT CHECK +
WEB SEARCH) RUN LONGER RATHER THAN
TRUNCATE QUALITY, PER MARCUS. REVISIT
ONCE REAL LATENCIES ARE MEASURED.

"COOKING ONLY" IS PRIYA'S SUMMARY OF THE
SAME UNDERLYING GOAL MARCUS STATES
PRECISELY: ENGAGE WITH FOOD-ADJACENT
TOPICS (PAIRINGS, GEAR, HOSTING),
POLITELY REDIRECT THE CLEARLY UNRELATED.
NOT A REAL CONFLICT ONCE READ CLOSELY.

DIANE'S EMAIL STATES THIS EXPLICITLY AS
NON-NEGOTIABLE AND PRODUCT-BLOCKING.
ACKNOWLEDGE A STATED CONDITION GENERICALLY
("NOTED — PLEASE CONFIRM WITH A
PROFESSIONAL"), NEVER ADAPT SUGGESTIONS TO
IT. MARCUS'S AMBITION HERE IS DEFERRED, NOT
BUILT, AND FLAGGED IN SCOPING.MD AS A
CONTRADICTION RESOLVED IN LEGAL'S FAVOR.
